definitions.gloss: cross-section diagram; cross-sectional view; cutaway drawing
definitions.explanation: A diagram showing what an object or structure looks like when cut through, revealing its internal structure. Used in engineering, architecture, science, and everyday explanations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断面図|だんめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I looked at the cross-section diagram of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断面図|だんめんず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っていた→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: There was a cross-section diagram of the Earth in the textbook.

examples.japanese: ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断面図|だんめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I used a cross-section diagram of the engine to explain the internal mechanism.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{断面|だんめん}→断面：21317_danmen⟧ (cross-section, cut surface) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断面図|だんめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧ (to draw a cross-section)
- {断面図|だんめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (to show a cross-section)
- {縦|たて}{断面図|だんめんず} (longitudinal cross-section)
- {横|よこ}{断面図|だんめんず} (transverse cross-section)

Related technical drawing types include ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧ (floor plan / plan view) and ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧ (elevation / front view).
